additional_concerns: The formula preserves the two-route structure but delegates exposure measurement, LAF identification and designation verification to supplied judgments. It does not establish the correctness of those judgments.

Footnote 7 situates discretionary designation below 50% of NAV. The unrestricted OR does not change a known classification result at or above 50%, because the mandatory route already applies; an operative designation must nevertheless be verified rather than inferred from risk factors.
The circular supplies no persistence or declassification rule. The assessment-time convention must not be interpreted as permitting cessation of an earlier classification.
Global conflict blocking can prevent a result even when an independently established route would suffice. This is an evidentiary runtime restriction, not an additional legal classification condition.
The supplied dependency IDs have no identifying metadata or source hashes. None can reliably be matched to a named external authority.
